supersedes: Pre-GPU assertions in axk2-verdict.json; preserves its pinned-vLLM unsupported verdict.
outcome: A100-compatible alternative operators and a correctness-first prototype demonstrated. Full 688B inference, response quality, multi-GPU/multi-node serving and production performance remain unverified.

cloud.spot_allocation: Succeeded using existing separate regional Spot quota
cloud.note: One opportunistic Spot allocation is not production capacity or SLA evidence. No second GPU or cluster created.

root_cause_of_numerical_comparisons.not: Not executing unsupported SM90 kernels on SM80; these GPU tests used the supported PyTorch implementation.
root_cause_of_numerical_comparisons.observed: Eager/SDPA rounding differences in layer0 changed sparse top-k selections for 6 of 4096 layer1 query positions in the FP32 trace, amplifying downstream differences.
root_cause_of_numerical_comparisons.limitations: Random weights. This is not evidence of trained-model response degradation, nor proof that exact cross-backend equality should be a universal quality gate.

prototype.backend: Transformers AXK2 eager, fixed within the test
prototype.compute: FP32 attention, indexer, residual path and FFN calculations; TF32 disabled
prototype.weight_storage: BF16 FFN/expert storage with one selected expert expanded at a time. Dense/shared MLP weights expanded only during that module's call.
prototype.status: Experimental custom inference implementation, not a supported SKT vLLM configuration.
prototype.not_done: No full-checkpoint loader, sharded serving integration or optimized SM80 sparse kernel.

original_geometry_4k.scope_warning: Random 2-layer model, not the trained 61-layer model. Timings and memory cannot be extrapolated as production 688B measurements.

strict_8k_limit.observation: One of 2048 selected indices differed for one tested layer/query. Threshold was not widened and this result is not classified as a pass.

actual_public_fp8_expert.method: Exact HTTP ranges, original block scales, pinned official Transformers Fp8Dequantize helper, FP32 CUDA matmul. No native FP8 matmul used.
actual_public_fp8_expert.scope_warning: Only one expert, not a complete real-weight layer or model. This FP8-storage experiment is separate from the BF16-storage 2-layer prototype.

memory_implication: The real expert experiment shows all expert weights need not be expanded permanently to BF16/FP32. Extending this into a full loader may preserve FP8 storage, but aggregate original weights still require roughly 656 GiB plus scales/runtime/sharding overhead. No full-model memory guarantee.
next_gate: Separately approved two-GPU/two-node sharding experiment, plus real-weight attention/loading/quality validation and end-to-end performance measurement. Do not present current results as a customer production case.
cleanup: See a100-cleanup-confirmation.json for final verified cloud cleanup state.
